retrievalProfile.description: A soft-focus studio portrait featuring a subject in casual 70s attire against a pale blue backdrop with a distinct chain-link fence shadow overlay.
triggerTerms: shadow of chain link fence on wall

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a woman with voluminous curly hair, wearing an oversized light pink pinstripe shirt and blue jeans. She stands against a light blue wall that catches a sharp, diagonal shadow of a chain-link fence. The lighting is soft and diffused on the subject, creating a dreamy, nostalgic atmosphere typical of late 70s pop-rock aesthetics.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a textured shadow background
Soft, warm skin tones contrasting with cool blue background
Loose, casual clothing silhouette against a geometric shadow pattern
Handwritten script floating at the top margin

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot, subject occupying the middle vertical third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and voluminous hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the handwritten text at the top, moves down to the subject's face, then follows the diagonal lines of the fence shadow.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample space around the subject's head and shoulders to accommodate the shadow pattern and text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, medium-high value; a 'washed out' vintage look.

letterConstructionRules: Variable line weight based on speed
Connected lowercase letters with high ascenders
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase letters are larger and more expressive versions of the script
Terminals end in soft, rounded points
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single expressive script to maintain a personal, 'signed' feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the rapid, informal feel of the original lettering.
Captures the specific stroke quality of the source.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A soft-focus portrait of a woman with 70s curly hair wearing an oversized pink pinstripe shirt, standing against a light blue wall with a diagonal chain-link fence shadow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of black marker-style cursive script centered at the top of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the fence shadow clearly visible but not distracting?
Does the lighting feel soft and diffused like a 70s film photo?
Is the script fluid and handwritten in appearance?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
Exact brand logos or specific names
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the pinstripes on the shirt are subtle and thin.
Check that the shadow pattern follows the perspective of the wall.
Verify the script looks like it was written with a physical marker.
Confirm the color palette remains in the muted pastel range.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + [Subject Description] + [70s Soft Focus] + [Chain Link Shadow Background] + [Marker Script Header]
